HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 1 of 2
Series Seed Preferred Stock Purchase Agreement, June 21, 2011
Section 1. Sale. Harbor Labs, Inc. sells 395,370 shares of Series Seed Preferred to
Alder Peak Ventures, L.P. at $3.75 per share, for $1,482,637.50.
Section 2. Payment. The purchase price is due by wire within three business days
after the closing.
Section 3.2. Capitalization. The capitalization immediately after the closing is as
set out in Schedule 3.2 of the Disclosure Schedule.
Section 3.6. Litigation. No action is pending or, to the company's knowledge,
threatened against it, other than as disclosed.

HARBOR LABS SAMPLE RECORD. Fictional: every name, date and number is invented.
Page 2 of 2
Section 3.9. Intellectual Property. Each founder has assigned to the company all
technology used in its business, and no former employer of a founder has any right
to that technology, other than as disclosed.
Section 3.12. Tax elections. Each founder made a timely election under Section 83(b)
for the founder shares, other than as disclosed.
Section 5. Conditions. The closing is conditioned on the restated charter being
filed and on a good standing certificate from Delaware dated within 10 days before
the closing.
Section 7. Survival. The company's statements in this agreement survive for 18
months after the closing.
